question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4,000 at 7.5% per annum rate of interest deposited on 8 February 2024 and withdrawn on 9 April 2024.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total days from 8 Feb to 9 Apr 2024 = 21 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 9 (Apr) = 61 days.

Since 2024 is a leap year, time T = 61 ÷ 366 = 1/6 years.

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

SI = 4000 × 7.5 × (1/6) ÷ 100 = 300 ÷ 6 = 50

**∴ The correct answer is ₹50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,000

Rate of interest (R) = 7.5% per annum

Time period = 8 February 2024 to 9 April 2024
